title: No Pressure
description: A Minecraft mod pack designed to enhance the Vanilla experience without enforcing a specific playstyle.
body:
![Banner for the mod pack "No Pressure"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c58ec4e67b4de257897968d73d01055b7151f06b.png)**No-Pressure is a modpack focused on modernizing and opening up the default Minecraft experience.**

The prominent changes (other than basic optimization mods we are all familiar with) are as follows:
- Overworld terrain revamped with [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic) & [CliffTree](https://modrinth.com/datapack/clifftree)
- Game Rebalances such as [minecart buffs](https://modrinth.com/mod/fast-minecart)
- Bedrock parity with [Snowy Leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/visual-snowy-leaves) & [Cauldron Expansions](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cauldron-expansion)
 - A variety of visual and auditory improvements
- Logical item expansions such as those from [Puck's Parity Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/pucks-parity-mod)
- Peaceful compatibliy with [Notblue's Vegan Recipes](https://modrinth.com/datapack/vegan-recipes)
